echoindex.entry.category.items.subtitle: Item Lookup
echoindex.entry.category.items.summary: Search item records, recipe outputs, usage paths, and linked source cards.
echoindex.entry.category.items.body: Items are the fastest way into Index. Hover an inventory stack and press R for recipes or U for uses, then follow source cards when an item comes from caches, routes, missions, or machines.
echoindex.entry.category.blocks.subtitle: World And Placement Records
echoindex.entry.category.blocks.summary: Blocks connect world placement, loot tables, recipes, and source records.
echoindex.entry.category.blocks.body: Block entries help identify where materials drop, which workstations use them, and which structures or hazards mention them.
echoindex.entry.category.machines.summar: Machine cards explain process inputs, outputs, catalysts, and integration ownership.
echoindex.entry.category.machines.body: EchoIndex treats machine processes as provider-owned recipe cards so each addon can publish accurate process context without Index hardcoding another module's rules.
echoindex.entry.category.tools.subtitle: Field Utility
echoindex.entry.category.tools.summary: Tools collect utility gear, Lens-adjacent actions, repairs, and survival helpers.
echoindex.entry.category.tools.body: Use tool entries to trace repair ingredients, field uses, and addon-specific interactions that are not obvious from vanilla recipes.
echoindex.entry.category.combat.subtitle: Weapons And Defense
echoindex.entry.category.combat.summary: Combat entries cover weapons, armor, defensive gear, and hazard-adjacent loadouts.
echoindex.entry.category.combat.body: Combat records are intended to connect equipment recipes with route rewards, faction supplies, and survival constraints.
echoindex.entry.category.recipes.summary: Recipe cards show outputs, uses, machines, catalysts, locked hints, and transfer readiness.
echoindex.entry.category.recipes.body: Recipe visibility stays player-friendly by default. Discovery can enrich progression without hiding practical crafting information unless stricter config options are enabled.
echoindex.entry.category.sources.summary: Source cards explain non-recipe acquisition such as loot, caches, structures, routes, missions, traders, research, and worldgen.
echoindex.entry.category.sources.body: Owning addons can publish source facts through datapack JSON or IIndexSourceProvider. Index merges those facts with safe loot table and worldgen scans.
echoindex.entry.category.tutorials.summa: Tutorial entries collect player guidance for Index and the wider ECHO stack.
echoindex.entry.category.tutorials.body: TutorialCore can publish guided records here while Index keeps quick lookup controls visible from inventory and Terminal surfaces.
echoindex.entry.category.lore.subtitle: Recovered Archive
echoindex.entry.category.lore.summary: Lore entries hold field notes, recovered records, and chapter context.
echoindex.entry.category.lore.body: Lore remains addon-owned. Index provides a shared archive surface and links records back to items, sources, and routes.
echoindex.entry.category.research.summar: Research entries explain unlocks, schematics, discoveries, and technical records.
echoindex.entry.category.research.body: Research cards are designed to show why something is locked and where to pursue it next without taking authority away from the owning addon.
echoindex.entry.category.routes.subtitle: Pathfinding And Progress
echoindex.entry.category.routes.summary: Route entries connect HoloMap, WorldCore, MissionCore, and chapter recovery paths.
echoindex.entry.category.routes.body: Route source facts should explain where resources become available, which hazards apply, and which missions or maps point to the next path.
echoindex.entry.category.hazards.summary: Hazard entries connect environment threats to filters, equipment, routes, and diagnostics.
echoindex.entry.category.hazards.body: WorldCore and chapter addons can publish hazard records so players can search for both the danger and the practical counter.
echoindex.entry.category.factions.summar: Faction entries connect traders, contracts, standing, rewards, and route consequences.
echoindex.entry.category.factions.body: Faction data remains owned by the faction systems. Index links public-facing context, rewards, and source facts for planning.
echoindex.entry.category.diagnostics.sum: Diagnostics entries summarize loaded modules, optional bridges, validation status, and provider health.
echoindex.entry.category.diagnostics.bod: Use diagnostics when a recipe, source, or addon record looks missing. The /echoindex validate command reports missing links, bad ids, provider failures, and source-card issues.
echoindex.entry.index_overview.subtitle: Shared Knowledge Archive
echoindex.entry.index_overview.summary: Browse items, recipes, uses, discoveries, tutorials, and addon records from one ECHO archive.
echoindex.entry.index_overview.body: ECHO: Index catalogs player-facing content across the ECHO ecosystem. Use the inventory overlay for quick recipe and usage lookup, or open the Terminal archive for richer codex records.
echoindex.command.list: ECHO Index // Categories %s, entries %s, recipe categories %s, recipes %s.
